subject.title: fix(line): AI-assisted - requireMention can now optionally gate non-text messages with bounded pending-media retention

question: Should LINE adopt the new `requireMentionForNonText` and `pendingMediaLimit` delayed-delivery contract once the concurrency defect is fixed?
rationale: The proposal adds persistent configuration and intentionally associates media from an earlier group event with a later mentioned turn, so product acceptance cannot be inferred from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Approve bounded opt-in retention
options.body: Preserve current default passthrough and accept both settings after per-group serialization and real LINE proof.

options.title: Approve gating without retention
options.body: Offer opt-in non-text suppression but discard skipped media rather than attaching it to a later turn.

options.title: Keep current passthrough
options.body: Decline the new settings and leave non-text messages outside LINE mention gating.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded opt-in retention
recommendation.body: Preserve current default passthrough and accept both settings after per-group serialization and real LINE proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged implementation established the current LINE mention-gating and pending-history contract that this proposal changes.
